scope: Parent replay of the six exact strengthened P1 formulas only (source P1 leaf + 126-clause M_s tail; CaDiCaL 3.0.1 -> named FIFO -> parent drat-trim, measured parent feeds). Results are exact-formula facts; their transfer to the four open P1 templates needs separate parent acceptance of the normal form r2. It establishes no n=8 or Problem-16 conclusion and makes no theorem claim.

inputs.not_rederived_here: ALO-domain/name-table identity of the four deleted clauses (inherited from the parent binding RESULT above; leaf bytes do not depend on it)

inputs_strengthened.composition: STRONG_HEADER + unchanged weak body + the source leaf's 42 unit lines + M_s tail

worker_results.use: read only to learn IDs, solve seconds and peaks; nothing else is taken from it

items.name: unsat
items.preregistered_expectation: PASS under the leaf acceptance rules
items.purpose: pipeline self-test on a synthetic 3-variable formula; not part of the replay

items.name: sat-checker
items.preregistered_expectation: not s VERIFIED (checker formula is satisfiable)
items.purpose: pipeline self-test on a synthetic 3-variable formula; not part of the replay

items.projected_rule: max(1.5 x worker aggregate peak 4389044224 of source template P1-B1, floor 4939212390)
items.acceptance: PASS iff all of: solver rc 20; solver status lines (log with only '\r' removed, lines starting with 's') exactly ['s UNSATISFIABLE']; checker rc 0; checker log with only '\r' removed has a line exactly 's VERIFIED' and contains neither 's NOT VERIFIED' nor 's TIMEOUT'; no safety stop; solver and checker writer threads ok, written == formula length, and sha256 of the bytes each actually wrote == the bound strengthened hash; stricter than the brief: drat-trim's 'c parsing input formula' line reports the header's variable and clause counts and the checker log has no 'early EOF' or 'clauses less than expected' warning. Anything else is UNKNOWN, with reasons (SAT report, proof rejection, feed mismatch, timeout, guard stop, writer error, other). After a SAT report (rc 10 or 's SATISFIABLE') the model stays in the solver log and the desk launches nothing more; after a floor or safety stop the desk launches nothing more; any other UNKNOWN continues with the next formula. No retries without parent approval.

gate: Before each launch a fresh lane scan (native solver/checker processes plus python processes whose cwd or argv lies in the lane or a review/moqls8-* desk, excluding this desk's driver and children; python counts as busy if its CPU use over a 2 s libproc window is >= 50%; lane RSS conservatively includes every such python, busy or not) and a fresh statvfs: launch only if lane busy + 2 <= 4, lane RSS + projected <= 7.6 GiB and free >= 12,200,000,000 + 10 MiB. Stricter than the brief: two consecutive passing checks 60 s apart are required, so a launch never rides a transient gap of the priority worker pipeline. Otherwise sleep 60 s and re-check; total gate wait per run bounded by 6 h, then stop and report deferral. No launch at or after 2026-10-18 17:29:00 PDT (host clock; 60 s margin before the 17:30 cutoff). Projected peak = max(1.5 x worker aggregate peak of the formula's source template leaf (the worker's 900 s attempt; no worker run of a strengthened formula exists), 4.6 GiB); self-tests 512 MiB.
in_flight_stops: In flight, every 0.25 s: desk aggregate RSS (driver + live children, libproc) and free space; lane scan every >= 1 s. SIGTERM own children if lane RSS (other lane processes + desk) > 7.85 GiB, desk aggregate > projected + 0.5 GiB, free < 12,000,000,000, wall > 3600 + 7200 + 120 s, the host clock reaches 2026-10-18 17:57:00 PDT, the checker exits while the solver still runs, or the driver receives SIGTERM; then wait at most 120 s, never escalate; result UNKNOWN and the desk launches nothing more.
transport: CNF bytes in parent memory -> anonymous pipes (/dev/fd/N) with per-writer sha256 of the bytes written; proof: cadical -> named FIFO in fifo/ -> drat-trim stdin (-i). No CNF or proof file on disk. Each native tool gets its own new TMPDIR and cwd, tmp/<label>/solver/ and tmp/<label>/checker/.
sequencing: one pipeline at a time, items in the listed order; a failed self-test aborts the run before any formula; after a SAT report, a floor/safety stop, a driver SIGTERM or the 17:29 PDT launch cutoff nothing more is launched; any other UNKNOWN continues with the next formula
